title: Yummy Crispy Thai Chicken Bao
description: Fatty, crispy, cozy Thai dish featuring cinnamon and Ayurvedic-friendly ingredients, inspired by Bangkok street food.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: infused with cinnamon and star anise

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour and cinnamon stick pieces.
Add chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat 1/2 cup of infused olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken breast to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, and red chili flakes in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened slightly.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and serve in a crispy Bao bun with the coconut milk sauce and garnish with scallions.
